title: Energy Level Prediction of Organic Semiconductors for Photodetectors and Mining of a Photovoltaic Database to Search for New Building Units
summary: Machine-learning models trained on literature-derived molecular descriptors estimate organic-semiconductor energy levels and screen a photovoltaic database for candidate building units; the candidates are computationally prioritized and not synthesized or measured here.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The study evaluates descriptor-based energy-level predictions and database screening; candidate building units were computationally prioritized and not experimentally synthesized or measured.
